headerDisplay: To get started you will need to generate an API key from https://webhooks.loqed.com by logging in with your Loqed account and choosing 'Add API Key'. You need to repeat this for each lock you have and add the config below

webhookPort.title: Webhook port (use a different port for each lock)
webhookPort.description: Set the LOQED bridge webhook URL to http://<homebridge-ip>:<webhookPort>/webhook.

bridgeIP.title: The IP address of your bridge. This is used to verify hooks that come to your homebridge for security. We recommend you fix you bridges IP on your local network or some functionality may stop working

footerDisplay:
### Full JSON configuration template

The JSON Config editor starts with only `platform` and `name`. Replace that block with the template below and fill in your lock details, including the actual Local Key ID. Alternatively, use the Settings form. For multiple locks, give every lock its own child bridge using the Homebridge UI Child Bridge settings, as well as a unique `webhookPort`. Each child bridge needs a unique username and HomeKit port. Restart all of Homebridge after adding a lock.

```json
{
    "platform": "HomebridgeLoqed",
    "name": "Your Lock Name",
    "localKeyID": 1,
    "key": "",
    "token": "",
    "lockID": "",
    "bridgeIP": "",
    "webhookPort": 4567
}
```
